title: DNS over QUIC RFC 9250 Extended Protocol Errors Verification
verification_method: Focused raw loopback tests, unit tests, SpecTrace JSON validation, and diff hygiene for extended protocol error enforcement.
scope: This verification covers EDNS(0) tcp-keepalive rejection, server-initiated bidirectional stream detection, missing STREAM FIN timeout enforcement, and unknown/unexpected-context error code normalization within the DoQ adapter.
preconditions: The DoQ foundation and earlier slices (0001-0007) exist and pass.
Managed QUIC loopback support is available for raw server stream synthesis tests.
expected_result: The focused DoQ fatal-error tests pass, core SpecTrace validation accepts the RFC 9250 artifacts including slice 0008, and no whitespace hygiene issues are introduced.
status_summary: The DoQ adapter now proves EDNS(0) tcp-keepalive rejection, server-initiated bidirectional stream detection, missing STREAM FIN timeout enforcement, and unknown/unexpected-context error code normalization. All four REQs are traced and verified.
